title: I'm running a Vibe Game Jam with 300$ in prizes
author: Pixar3d
selftext:
Hi, I'm organizing an online Game Jam with 300$ in prizes and also a voucher of 20$ in Qwen credits for all the participants

  
Learn more: [https://summergamejam.vibecodezone.com/](https://summergamejam.vibecodezone.com/)

  
Feel free to ask me anything

https://preview.redd.it/cci7bli985lh1.png?width=1857&format=png&auto=webp&s=9384c2ad0dee637495a7916bd95401a44155f5e1

comments.author: tabaxi_gf
comments.body: Is $20 the limit of what you can use on qwen for the competition?  One issue I wonder for AI jams (only done traditional before) is I wonder if it’s the case that whoever throws the most money at it will win

replies.author: Pixar3d
replies.body:
No, 20$ is just a voucher for use Qwen AI, but you can use what you want and even other ai models.  
I know that usually who most spend is who wins but we will try to evaluate some aspects more than the most polished game, such as originality and fun which doesn't depend at all of the money. Will evaluate it as much fair as we can
